zh.name: 看图猜答案
zh.summary: 用编号图片提出可以作答的问题，先保留答案，再提供依据和揭晓。
zh.useWhen: 必须有可核验答案；区别于没有标准答案的偏好投票。
zh.instructions: 问题、候选图、真实答案、判定依据与揭晓素材
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Visual Guess Quiz
en.summary: Create an Instagram quiz carousel using the visual guess quiz structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the visual guess quiz format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 封面暖白底，上方混合衬线/无衬线问题72–92px，下面大图占65%，右下大序号40–50px
后页交替全幅题图与小型问题/时限，答案页单独给出图源/依据，避免提前暴露
